events.label: Any Sight Seers activity
events.activities: a tour, excursion, team event or other activity organised by Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures ("Sight Seers") in the Caribbean, including travel by coach, van or boat between the meeting point and the activity

events.label: The Summit Challenge
events.activities: The Summit Challenge, a scored team event, organised by Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures ("Sight Seers"). It includes a climbing relay, laser tag, an ATV ride, a train tour and team games, and travel by coach, including the connector service, between the meeting point and the venue. Some activities are provided by third-party venue operators and guides
bring: Comfortable activewear suited to climbing and laser tag
Snacks, as food stops can be limited

Do you take any regular medication we should know about?
Are you pregnant, or have you had surgery or a serious injury in the last 6 months?

clauses.t: I am taking part in {activities}. I understand some activities are provided by third-party operators and guides.

I understand these activities involve physical effort and real risks, including falls, collisions, strains, sprains, cuts, bruises, broken bones, heat and sun exposure, insect bites, and, rarely, serious injury or death. Road and water travel and weather add further risks. I understand these risks cannot be removed completely, even with care, instructions and safety equipment.

I will follow the safety briefing and the instructions of the Sight Seers Team Lead, guides and operators. I will use the equipment provided as shown. I will not take part while under the influence of alcohol or drugs. I will wear suitable clothing and footwear. I will stop an activity and tell someone if I feel unwell or unsafe. I am fit to take part, or I have told the Team Lead about anything that affects that.
I choose to take part and I accept the risks described above.

To the fullest extent the law allows, I release and agree not to hold Sight Seers, its owners, directors, employees, guides, Team Leads, contractors and agents, and the venue, transport and activity operators it works with (together, "the Released Parties"), responsible for any injury, illness, death, loss, or damage to me or my belongings that happens because of my taking part or the travel connected to it, including injury caused by the ordinary negligence of a Released Party, and whether the claim is framed as negligence, breach of contract, breach of a legal duty or accident. I understand that by signing I am giving up my right to sue for such loss. This release also covers the successors and assigns of the Released Parties.
This waiver does not limit anyone's liability where the law does not allow it to be limited, including liability for death or personal injury caused by gross negligence or deliberate wrongdoing.
This waiver is also binding on my next of kin, personal representatives, heirs and beneficiaries, so that no one can bring a claim on my behalf for loss I have released here.

I agree to cover the Released Parties for any costs, expenses or claims they face because of something I do, or fail to do, that causes injury or damage to another person or to property while I am taking part, and for any claim brought by someone else because of my participation.

clauses.h: If part of this is struck out
clauses.t: If any part of this waiver is found to be invalid or cannot be enforced, the rest of it still applies in full.

I understand some activities may be far from medical help, and that the Team Lead can give first aid until professional help arrives. If I am injured or become ill, I allow Sight Seers and the Team Lead to arrange first aid and emergency medical care for me, and I will be responsible for the cost of any treatment or transport that is not paid by someone else. Sight Seers is not a medical provider.
I understand that I am responsible for my own health and accident insurance.
I will take care of equipment I am given. I may be asked to leave an activity, without a refund, if my behaviour puts myself or others at risk.

Sight Seers keeps a signed copy of this waiver on file, and I am emailed my own copy. The information I have given in this form is used to run the event and keep me safe. Sight Seers keeps it only as long as it needs to and does not sell it.
This waiver is governed by the laws of Jamaica, and I accept the jurisdiction of the courts of Jamaica.
I have read this waiver, I understand it, and I sign it freely. I am 18 or older.

photoClause: I allow Sight Seers to photograph and film the event and to use images of me to promote its services.
